places-pasture-house-turret-3a-the-engli.story: A 299 km round trip from Annan - roughly 5 h 09 in the saddle. It goes by way of Throp Roman fortlet, The English Lake District and back through Throp Roman fortlet. It strings together lakeside roads.

places-sanctuary-of-plateros-temple-of-n.story: A 355 km round trip from Plateros - roughly 6 h 07 in the saddle. It goes by way of Historic Centre of Zacatecas, Stretch of the Camino Real between Ojocali, Temple of Nuestra Señora de los Dolores in and back through Stretch of the Camino Real between Ojocali. The highest point is about 2,350 m. The line favours views over speed.
